pli-tv-bu-vb-pc11:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Āḷaviyaṃ viharati Aggāḷave cetiye.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc11:1.2: tena kho pana samayena Āḷavikā bhikkhū navakammaṃ karontā rukkhaṃ chindanti pi chedāpenti pi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc11:1.3: aññataro pi Āḷaviko bhikkhu rukkhaṃ chindati,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc11:1.4: tasmiṃ rukkhe adhivatthā devatā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc11:1.5: mā bhante attano bhavanaṃ kattukāmo mayhaṃ bhavanaṃ chindīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc11:1.6: so bhikkhu anādiyanto chindi yeva tassā ca devatāya dārakassa bāhuṃ ākoṭesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc11:1.7: atha kho tassā devatāya etad ahosi: yaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc11:1.8: nūnāhaṃ imaṃ bhikkhuṃ idh' eva jīvitā voropeyyan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc11:1.9: atha kho tassā devatāya etad ahosi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc11:1.10: na kho me taṃ patirūpaṃ yāhaṃ imaṃ bhikkhuṃ idh 'eva jīvitā voropeyyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc11:1.11: yaṃ nūnāhaṃ bhagavato etam atthaṃ āroceyyan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc11:1.12: atha kho sā devatā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc11:1.14: sādhu kho tvaṃ devate taṃ bhikkhuṃ jīvitā na voropesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc11:1.15: sac' ajja tvaṃ devate taṃ bhikkhuṃ jīvitā voropeyyāsi, bahuñ ca tvaṃ devate apuññaṃ pasaveyyāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc11:1.16: gaccha tvaṃ devate, amukasmiṃ okāse rukkho vivitto, tasmiṃ upagacchā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc11:1.18: kathañ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā rukkhaṃ chindissanti pi chedāpessanti pi. ekindriyaṃ samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā jīvaṃ viheṭhentīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc11:1.19: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc11:1.20: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc11:1.21: kathañ hi nāma Āḷavikā bhikkhū rukkhaṃ chindissanti pi chedāpessanti pīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc11:1.22: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave rukkhaṃ chindatha pi chedāpetha pīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc11:1.25: kathañ hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā rukkhaṃ chindissathāpi chedāpessathāpi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc11:1.27: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc11:1.28: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc11:2.1.2: pañca bījajātāni, mūlabījaṃ khandhabījaṃ phaḷubījaṃ aggabījaṃ bījabījañ c' eva pañcamaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc11:2.1.4: haliddi siṅgiveraṃ vacaṃ vacatthaṃ ativisaṃ kaṭukarohiṇī usīraṃ bhaddamuttakaṃ yāni vā pan' aññāni pi atthi mūle jāyanti mūle sañjāyanti, etaṃ mūlabījaṃ nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc11:2.1.6: assattho nigrodho pilakkho udumbaro kacchako kapiṭhano yāni vā pana aññāni pi atthi khandhe jāyanti khandhe sañjāyanti, etaṃ khandhabījaṃ nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc11:2.1.8: ucchu veḷu naḷo yānivā pan' aññāni pi atthi pabbe jāyanti pabbe sañjāyanti, etaṃ phaḷubījaṃ nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc11:2.1.10: ajjukaṃ phaṇijjakaṃ hiriveraṃ yāni vā pan' aññāni pi atthi agge jāyanti agge sañjāyanti, etaṃ aggabījaṃ nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc11:2.1.12: pubbaṇṇaṃ aparaṇṇaṃ yāni vā pan' aññāni pi atthi bīje jāyanti bīje sañjāyanti, etaṃ bījabījaṃ nāma. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc11:2.2.1: bīje bījasaññī chindati vā chedāpeti vā bhindati vā bhedāpeti vā pacati vā pacāpeti vā, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc11:2.2.2: bīje vematiko chindati vā . . . pacāpeti vā, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc11:2.2.3: bīje abījasaññī chindati vā . . . pacāpeti vā, anāpatti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc11:2.3.2: imaṃ jāna imaṃ dehi imaṃ āhara iminā attho imaṃ kappiyaṃ karohīti bhaṇati,
